articles.summary: SINGAPORE, Oct. 07, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - SMJ International Holdings Inc. (NYSE American: SMJF) (the “ Company ”) today announced that it has received a public warning letter, dated October 6, 2026 (the “ Warning Letter ”), issued by NYSE Regulation on behalf of NYSE American LLC (the “ Exchange ”), regarding the Company’s disclosure of material news in a manner that failed to comply with Section 401(a) of the NYSE American Company Guide (the “ Company Guide ”). Section 401(a) of the Company Guide requires a listed company to make immediate public disclosure of all material information concerning its affairs and, when such disclosure is to be made between 7:00 A.M. and 4:00 P.M. Eastern Time, to notify the Exchange at least ten minutes prior to the announcement. According to the Warning Letter, at approximately 4:33 P.M. Eastern Time on October 1, 2026, the Company filed a Report on Form 6-K with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the “ SEC ”) disclosing, among other
articles.title: SMJ International Holdings Inc. Receives a Warning Letter from NYSE American LLC
